task_title: Add optional AI merchant weapon purchase

plan_review.notes: Adopted a shared observable per-world accessor module over an opaque local WeakMap; latch stock selection immediately on the buy branch; compare deficit farm time to canonical slack without mutating planner segments or double-counting safety; add explicit post-quest farm/return/buy states; use forced bag equip semantics; latch terminal purchase to prevent repeats; share one typed world opt-in between BT and auto-progression; add explicit RNG/order/slack/CLI/equip tests. Rejected embedding optional work into canonical plan because it would make the detour mandatory; rejected max-cost proxy because the contract requires selected-weapon deficit.
